title: Superior Elixir of Arcane Cultivation
summary: Adds one level 3 spell slot until Long Rest.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Gain one level 3 slot until Long Rest. Replaces other elixirs.
fields.Alchemy: Extract 3 Night Orchids into Solution of Night Orchid, then mix with any Vitriol.
fields.Acquisition: Semi-random levelled merchant stock from level 6.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
